summary: Nora's daily look at open questions now knows which room each one came from, and whether she is allowed to speak there unprompted.
details: Each open question in the daily pass names the room it was raised in. A follow-up about it can only go to that room.
A question raised in a room where Nora only answers when spoken to is marked as such, so she stops trying to set follow-ups that were always going to be refused.
The daily pass may now check memory, read notes and set follow-ups more times per run.
limitations: Questions raised in a room without unprompted speech still get no follow-up anywhere; enabling that is a per-room setting.
